provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: The landing md/shared-typing.md#claim-shared.typing.reference_realization directly introduces shared.typing.reference_realization. Links read, normalized types, mode, allocation, pos/neg, valid paths, declared permission and composition. Its three conditions define access from a reference, including hidden routes. Compared inline notation, displayed rules/equations, and any code/table with the named dependencies. Satisfies requires matching root mode/class, allocated correctly classed results for all positive paths, empty slots for negative paths, and composed declared modes on every valid inhabited read, including paths omitted by the view. The three conditions preserve the distinction between a stored mode and effective path mode. Prerequisites are linked in the retained chapter; the selected body states this subject rather than asking the reader to find a definition elsewhere in a multipurpose chapter.
limitations: Author editorial self-review, not an independent review. Link extraction and byte-range validation do not prove the coverage or clarity judgment. Future notes remain nonnormative and this audit does not assert formal correspondence.
